import sys


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n = data[0]
    values = data[1:]
    del data

    order = sorted(range(n), key=values.__getitem__)
    left_tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    right_tree = [0] * (n + 1)

    modulus = 1_000_000_007
    total_right_weight = 0
    answer = 0

    for index in order:
        position = index + 1
        right_weight = n - index

        left_sum = 0
        right_prefix_sum = 0
        cursor = position
        while cursor:
            left_sum += left_tree[cursor]
            right_prefix_sum += right_tree[cursor]
            cursor -= cursor & -cursor

        right_sum = total_right_weight - right_prefix_sum
        contribution = (
            position * right_weight
            + right_weight * left_sum
            + position * right_sum
        )
        answer = (answer + values[index] * contribution) % modulus

        cursor = position
        while cursor <= n:
            left_tree[cursor] += position
            right_tree[cursor] += right_weight
            cursor += cursor & -cursor

        total_right_weight += right_weight

    print(answer)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
